headline: "Hormuz ready to reopen in 7 days". And oil price plunges below 100 euros a barrel. East-West pipeline reactivated in Saudi Arabia
summary: A senior Iranian official said the Strait of Hormuz is ready to reopen in seven days, reviving hopes of ending the naval blockade. Oil prices fell below 100 euros a barrel, and the East-West pipeline in Saudi Arabia was reactivated.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key route for Gulf oil exports, so disruptions there feed directly into global crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: A senior Iranian official's statement on reopening the Strait of Hormuz revived hopes of ending the naval blockade, and the report says oil fell below 100 euros a barrel.
